rubric.legibility: pass with finding 1. The population split the figure exists to show reads at a glance: 78 grey solved nodes sit within one decade just under 1e-9 mWb, three red promoted diamonds sit near 8 mWb of pasted trial-state mismatch, and the hollow withheld circles form their own band between 1 and 3 mWb. Both panels are labelled through one shared legend. Boundary: the spatial panel carries no scale reference of any kind (finding 1), and the solved population's own variation is compressed by the symlog linear interval (finding 2).
rubric.table_form: pass. The figure is a spatial map plus a per-node distribution against a threshold; neither is naturally a table, and the figures the caption needs numerically are already in the fragment's table.

findings.summary: The left (spatial) panel is drawn through poloidal_axes with its ticks cleared at :98-99 and no vessel, limiter or coil geometry in the panel, so the picture carries no scale: the base render had 'radius [m]' and 'lattice height [m]' axes here and the head render has none, and neither the alt text nor the caption (docs/evidence/fragments/separatrix-spline-extraction/display-map-solve-currents.html:58-59, which say only 'a 9 by 9 lattice') states the domain. A reader can see the arrangement of the three promoted diamonds, the X-point seed and the grey lattice but cannot read where they sit in metres, or what fraction of the plasma radius the lattice spans. Adding the radial and height extent to the caption, or drawing the wall that the axis-off rule assumes supplies scale, would restore it; the figure is otherwise readable.

The symlog scale (linthresh 1e-10 mWb, ylim -1e-10 .. 200 at :181, ticks set at :182) places the whole solved-node population -- 78 of the 81 marks and the figure's subject -- in the band between the 0 tick and 1e-9, where values below 1e-10 mWb are laid out linearly and the rest only just clear the threshold. On the render the population reads as a shallow wiggle a few pixels tall and its node-to-node variation cannot be read quantitatively, while the four decades between 1e-6 and 1e2 hold only the withheld band and the three promoted marks; the peak value the picture cannot show is carried by the caption's table instead. This is a deliberate, documented scale choice (caption: 'logarithmic above 1e-10 mWb and linear below it') and it does not stop the qualitative read, so it is recorded as a boundary rather than a repair.
